nodes.label: This release tidied up the contribution by [Teifun2](https://github.com/Teifun2) and added a new way to generate DNS challenge based certificate (e.g. wildcards) from Let's Encrypt without changing any environment variables. This also fixes a few previous ACME module EAB settings bug related to concurrent save.
